latest_release.name: React Native Windows 0.85.0
latest_release.body:
We're excited to release **React Native Windows 0.85.0** targeting React Native 0.85!

This release is built on **React Native 0.85.3**.

This release includes the commits to React Native Windows from **04/01/2026 –  10/19/2026**.

## Requirements

- **Visual Studio 2026** is required for RNW 0.85: [Upgrade to Visual Studio 2026 (#16170)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16170)
- Projects now build against **.NET 10**: [Upgrade projects to .NET 10 (#16226)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16226)
- Upgraded to **Windows App SDK 1.8** (1.8.260508005): [Upgrade to Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 1.8.260508005 (#16225)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16225)

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes & Upgrade Notes

- **New Architecture only** — the legacy architecture has been removed; apps on the old architecture must migrate to Fabric / the New Architecture: [Enable RCT_REMOVE_LEGACY_ARCH (#16157)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16157)
- **WebSocket internals unified** — the legacy `WinRTWebSocketResource` and `JSBigStringResourceDll` were removed; internal, but custom native forks touching these may need updates: [Remove old WinRTWebSocketResource implementation (#16229)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16229), [Remove JSBigStringResourceDll, and unify WebsocketResource (#16159)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16159)

## ✨ New Features & Enhancements

- Adds `hideTitleBar` and `hideBorder` props to Modal: [Add hideTitleBar and hideBorder to Modal (#16108)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16108)
- Implements `outline` style properties on View: [Implement outline properties on view (#16074)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16074)
- Adds `onAuxClick` event support: [Add onAuxClick event (6ca3cc9)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/commit/6ca3cc96b1385d6a6c1547db2f80e6bd212c2d41)
- Adds ability to make TurboModules eager init: [Add ability to make TurboModules eager init (#16093)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16093)
- Shows tooltip on keyboard focus and enforces a single visible tooltip: [Show tooltip on keyboard focus, enforce single visible tooltip (#16123)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16123)
- Exposes `ReactNativeWindow` from `ReactNativeWin32App`: [Expose ReactNativeWindow from ReactNativeWin32App (#16214)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16214)

## 🔧 Reliability & Stability

**Text & input**
- Fixes text input scaling with different screen scales: [Fix: text input scaling with different screen scales (#16288)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16288)
- Fixes Unicode text length calculation: [fix: Unicode Text length Calculation (#16219)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16219)
- Fixes multiline TextInput crash from `TxDrawD2D` reentrancy: [Fix multiline TextInput crash from TxDrawD2D reentrancy (#16003)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16003)
- Fixes x86 assert when using custom align: [Fix assert in x86 when using custom align (#16152)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16152)

**Touch, pointer & ScrollView**
- Improves touch event handling reliability and performance: [Fix touch event handling, improve reliability, and optimize performance (#16048)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16048)
- Fixes ScrollView Pressables stuck / dead tap on high-DPI displays: [Fix ScrollView Pressables stuck and dead tap on high-DPI displays (#16140)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/16140)
- Fixes ScrollView keyboard scroll drift on long key press: [Fix ScrollView keyboard scroll drift on long key press (#15988)](https://github.com/microsoft/react-native-windows/pull/15988)
- Cancels zombie touch state on ScrollView pointer-captur
